references.text: Jeremiah prophesies that sons and daughters will be devoured, which relates to the curse of losing one's children
Jeremiah is told not to have children because they will die from disease and be taken away, a direct parallel to the curse in Deuteronomy
Historical fulfillment where Nebuchadnezzar took the inhabitants of Jerusalem, including sons and daughters, into captivity in Babylon
A parallel curse in the same chapter where sons and daughters are given to another people
Jesus prophesies that the inhabitants of Jerusalem will be taken away as captives to all nations, an eschatological fulfillment of this curse
